title: Microsoft says GitHub is down worldwide, with its website, API, Actions, Pull Requests, and other services impacted; GitHub confirmed the outage at 13:40 UTC (Mayank Parmar/BleepingComputer)
summary: Mayank Parmar / BleepingComputer: Microsoft says GitHub is down worldwide, with its website, API, Actions, Pull Requests, and other services impacted; GitHub confirmed the outage at 13:40 UTC — GitHub is down for some users as a widespread outage is causing errors across the website, API, Actions, Pull Requests, and several other services.
